description:
Show a person 2 to 6 matching references side by side in their browser and let them click the
one to build from. Returns a URL to open for them; then call wait_for_pick with the pickId for
their choice and a build prompt. Only when a person is there to choose: autonomous agents
should use build_recipe.

component.description: Tag filter, as in search_screens, e.g. comparison-table.

count.description: How many options to show when searching, 2 to 6.

goal.description: What the user is building, shown on the page and used in the build prompt, e.g. "NSDR premium upgrade page".

kind.description: Only search this kind of screen.

pattern.description: Tag filter, as in search_screens, e.g. pricing-page.

q.description: Search words, e.g. "pricing page", "onboarding", "empty state". The best matches become the options. Can be combined with tag filters, or left out when tag filters are given.

screens.description: Comma-separated screen ids to show instead of searching, e.g. from an earlier search_screens.

stack.description: Preferred stack for the build prompt.

state.description: Tag filter, as in search_screens, e.g. empty.

task.description: Tag filter, as in search_screens, e.g. create.

name: pick_reference
title: Let the user pick a reference
